_artifact_note: DERIVED record of a Scite MCP `search_literature` term search made 2026-09-05, after the service-reported quota reset of 2026-09-03, for the one thing C1 lacked: an IL10 LIGAND cohort. Transcribed from the tool response: the total hit count and the DOI, year and title of every returned record (limit 10). Abstracts, excerpts and Smart Citation snippets were not retained. Outcome: none of the ten is an IL10 ligand loss-of-function cohort (NOX1, IFIH1, TNFAIP3, CASP8, an IL-10RA knock-in model, and reviews), so C1 stays WITHHELD.

_query.term: IL10 AND "loss-of-function" AND "early-onset inflammatory bowel disease" AND ("autosomal recessive" OR homozygous) NOT IL10RA NOT IL10RB
